title: Microgrid Controller Development Firmware Engineer - Morrisville/Raleigh, NC
description:
Who We Are:

Delta, founded in 1971, is a global provider of power and thermal management solutions. Its mission statement, "To provide innovative, clean and energy\-efficient solutions for a better tomorrow," focuses on addressing key environmental issues such as global climate change. As an energy\-saving solutions provider with core competencies in power electronics and automation, Delta's business categories include Power Electronics, Mobility, Automation, and Infrastructure.  

At Delta, we’re leading the energy transition with innovative solutions in solar inverters, energy storage systems, and EV charging infrastructure. Our technologies are helping utilities, businesses, and communities decarbonize and build resilient, intelligent energy ecosystems. Join us in creating a cleaner, smarter energy future.  

Role Summary
You will own the design and in\-house development of the real\-time control software that runs on the Microgrid Controller (MGC). This role sits at the intersection of power\-electronics control theory and deterministic embedded software, building the droop / grid\-forming / grid\-following, dispatch, mode\-transition, and protection logic that coordinates PCS, BESS, PV, and genset assets. You will bring hands\-on knowledge of industry\-grade controllers and translate control laws into safe, bounded, real\-time code verified on HIL.  


Key Responsibilities:
Develop the MGC real\-time control application on a deterministic RTOS/RT\-Linux target — droop/VSG, PLL, GFM/GFL reference generation, P/Q dispatch, and bumpless mode transitions within* 1 ms loops
* Implement secondary control (P\-f and Q\-V droop, virtual inertia, SOC\-aware allocation, ramp\-rate limiting, black\-start sequencing, resynchronization) at the 1–100 ms layer

Build protection coordination logic (50/51, 27/59, 81/81R, anti\-islanding, interlock state machine, GOOSE fast trip/block) with hardware trip paths executing in* 20 µs
* Design and tune power\-electronics control loop
